description: If you are ready to test it - go for it and feel free to follow my page because you’ll soon find it useful: to learn how you can keep on going when it’s hard
transcript: Do you know that your dreams can actually stop you? If you have that one big idea that you carry with yourself for years, the things that can change your life, you would not dare to test it. Because the moment you do it, you will figure out if it's a real thing or it's just hope. And you don't want to give up hope because hope feels so good. And instead of relying on one idea in your head, why wouldn't you rely on one amazing thing? Why wouldn't you decide that you will not stop until you figure it out one idea or another and just don't wait because until you try that out you're not actually changing your life
